content.comment_body: How can I access the time from [product_name] using a KINCO HMI? I tried mapping the suggested addresses from the manual, but they did not work for me. The manual mentions other compatible addresses and HMI devices, such as VM 991 A 1002. For HOUR/MINUTES: 994. For SECONDS: 997. For MONTH/DAY: 992. I was unable to retrieve the day of the week, and in the weekly timer it appears to be a byte. Thanks and best regards, [user_name]

The date and time values for [product_name] are stored in the VM area as integers: VB985 = year VB986 = month VB987 = day VB988 = hour VB989 = minute VB990 = second VB998 = day of the week (1 = Sunday, 2 = Monday, ..., 7 = Saturday)
You asked the same question in another thread: [product_name] TIME
Closed due to duplicate questions. The second thread titled [product_name] TIME was posted in the [product_name] - Communication conference. Best regards, [user_name]_Moderator
